newsitem.title: USA: Bruegger's founders leave Quality Dining board.
newsitem.headline: Bruegger's founders leave Quality Dining board.

text.p: Quality Dining Inc said Friday that the two founders of Bruegger's Bagel Bakeries, Nordahl Brue and Michael Dressell, have resigned from Quality Dining's board of directors.
The resignations come after the integration of the Bruegger's Bagel Bakeries acquisition was completed, Quality Dining said.

"We now will turn our time and attention to our other business interests, particularly our commitment to support Bruegger's as a franchisee of Bruegger's Bagel Bakeries," Brue and Dressell said in a statement released by Quality Dining.
Quality Dining completed the acquisition of Bruegger's in June.
